search.request.heading.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Search results row heading: titles found on the Seerr server, to request

seerr.title.request.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Button on a movie's page: ask the Seerr server for it

seerr.title.request_seasons.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Button on a show's page: ask for every season not on the server yet

seerr.title.requesting.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Button while the request is being sent

seerr.status.pending.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Status line: already requested, the server's owner has not approved it yet

seerr.status.processing.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Status line: approved and being downloaded

seerr.status.partly.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Status line: some seasons/parts are on the Plex server

seerr.status.available.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Status line: the title is on the Plex server

seerr.status.blocked.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Status line: the server's owner blocked requests for it

seerr.request.done.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Status line after a request went through

seerr.request.already.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Status line: somebody already requested it

seerr.request.forbidden.value: You can't request this on the server
seerr.request.forbidden.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Status line: this account may not request (no permission or over its limit)

seerr.request.failed.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Status line: the request did not go through

seerr.title.unreachable.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Whole-page message when the title could not be loaded from Seerr

seerr.menu.server.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Request menu section heading: which of the Seerr owner's Radarr/Sonarr servers the request goes to

seerr.menu.quality.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Request menu section heading: the quality profile the download uses

seerr.menu.folder.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Request menu section heading: the folder on the server the download is saved in

seerr.menu.free.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Request menu, a folder row's sub-line: {size} is the free disk space there, e.g. "1.8 GB"

seerr.menu.loading.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Request menu note while the server's choices are on their way

seerr.menu.unavailable.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: Request menu note: the servers, profiles or folders could not be read; the request can still be sent

seerr.info.original_language.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: A title's page: Information label: the language the title was made in; its value is the language's own name

seerr.info.directed_by.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: A title's page: Information label; its value is the director's name, or several separated by commas

seerr.info.written_by.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: A title's page: Information label; its value is the writers' names, separated by commas

seerr.info.created_by.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: A title's page: Information label for a show; its value is the creators' names, separated by commas

seerr.info.budget.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: A title's page: Information label for a movie; its value is what the movie cost to make, in US dollars

seerr.info.revenue.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: A title's page: Information label for a movie; its value is what it earned in cinemas worldwide, in US dollars

seerr.info.dollars.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: A title's page: An amount of US dollars as the budget and box office say it; {amount} is the number, grouped as the language groups numbers (165,000,000)

seerr.info.streaming.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: A title's page: Information label; its value is the streaming services in this television's country that carry the title

seerr.title.trailer_failed.description: Requesting a title through the household's Seerr server: A title's page: Status line when the Trailer button could not open the television's YouTube app
